entities.summary: Adam Joseph van Koeverden is a Canadian sprint kayaker, Olympic gold medallist, and politician serving since 2025 as the Secretary of State for Sport in Prime Minister Mark Carney's Cabinet. A member of the Liberal Party, he has represented the electoral district of Burlington North-Milton West and its predecessor district of Milton in the House of Commons since 2019.
